name: Invoice
description: Schema for extracting information from invoices

fields.name: invoice_number
fields.description: The unique identifier for the invoice

fields.name: invoice_date
fields.description: The date when the invoice was issued

fields.name: due_date
fields.description: The date by which payment must be made

fields.name: total_amount
fields.description: The total amount to be paid

fields.name: tax_amount
fields.description: The amount of tax included in the total

fields.name: vendor_name
fields.description: The name of the company issuing the invoice

fields.name: vendor_address
fields.description: The address of the company issuing the invoice

fields.name: vendor_contact
fields.description: Contact information for the vendor (phone, email, etc.)

fields.name: customer_name
fields.description: The name of the customer being billed

fields.name: customer_address
fields.description: The address of the customer being billed

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: The customer's account number or ID

fields.name: line_items
fields.description: A list of items or services being billed
